tail: Thy will, O Lord my God, God of judgment, that this may be a time of favour before Thee. Tear down in Thy many mercies and great kindnesses all partitions that separate Thee from Thy people Israel on this day. Remove from before Thee all opponents and accusers of Thy people Israel. Close Satan’s mouth that he may not oppose us, for towards Thee are our eyes suspended. I shall exalt Thee, my God, O King, God of judgment, who listens this day to the sound of prayers and Teruoth of Thy people Israel in compassion. Amen.
